name: mbot2-sim
description: Browser-based simulator for Makeblock mBot 2 with an Open Roberta Lab-compatible block editor in PT-PT

scripts.check: node scripts/or-fidelity-check.mjs > /dev/null && node scripts/codegen-check.mjs > /dev/null && node scripts/variables-check.mjs > /dev/null && node scripts/export-check.mjs > /dev/null && node scripts/sim-test.mjs > /dev/null && node scripts/levels-check.mjs --no-preview > /dev/null && node scripts/progress-check.mjs > /dev/null && node --no-warnings scripts/accounts-check.mjs > /dev/null && echo 'all checks passed'
